_comment: Seeded 2026-07-24 from the live 3-seat reader-panel FAIL (review-e4b6fde16): all seats flagged the source's exception-free thought-causes-circumstance absolutism as unsafe when asserted to a struggling reader, plus metaphor-reskin sameness across examples. RESTRUCTURED 2026-08-03: the two safety verdicts moved from notes into prohibitions, and the four absolutist wordings moved out of phrases. Both channels render under an OVER-USE header granting a quota of one and instructing the writer to paraphrase the item everywhere else — so as written, the safety rules were advisory and 'no exceptions' was budgeted for one permitted use. Only 'boat without a rudder' was ever a genuine over-use phrase.
frames: garden/weeds metaphor as the scene engine
weaver/garments metaphor as the scene engine
armoury/forge metaphor as the scene engine
tearing up tickets as a one-off theatrical resolution
notes: The three source metaphors (garden, weaver, armoury) may each anchor at most one teaching unit per chapter; other units must build fresh, concrete modern scenes rather than reskinning a metaphor onto a new character.
Each summary tier must add NEW information beyond the previous tier — no near-identical restatement of the redirect/forge point across Deep and Full reads.
Quiz distractors must be plausible on-topic claims, never thesis-contradicting keywords (random/disconnected/coincidence) a skimmer can eliminate without reading.
prohibitions: SAFETY (panel blocker, all 3 seats): never assert Allen's thought-circumstance link as an absolute, exception-free law, and never apply it to harm caused by others or to hardship generally. Frame it as Allen's claim about a strong tendency: attribute absolutist wording to the author ('Allen argues...'), and acknowledge in-text that external factors, other people, and luck also shape circumstances — the reader controls their response and habits, not everything that happens to them.

SAFETY: never write the thesis in exception-free wording. 'with no exceptions', 'no exceptions', 'always traces back to' and 'all his losses stem from' are banned outright — not rationed. There is no permitted first use and no acceptable paraphrase that restores the absolutism.

SAFETY: never model a coach/mentor telling a struggling person that their losses are caused by their own thoughts. Examples must show people changing their OWN patterns, never being blamed for what happened to them.

SAFETY: never advise a reader to address illness, injury, or a medical condition by working on their thinking. Where the source links health to thought, attribute it to Allen and keep it about habits and outlook; any chapter touching health must leave medical care intact as the reader's route, never displaced by mental discipline.
